tools.name: evolver_status
tools.description: Get the EvoMap Proxy status: running state, node_id, pending inbound/outbound message counts, and last Hub sync time. Use this first to confirm the Proxy is up.

tools.name: evolver_search_assets
tools.description: Search the EvoMap network for reusable evolution assets. Pass `signals` for literal signal/error tags and `text` for natural-language summary matching; optionally narrow with `kind`, `category`, or `gene`. A `degraded: true` response came from the local cache because the Hub was unavailable.

tools.name: evolver_fetch_asset
tools.description: Fetch reusable content by asset id. The result presents each asset summary, strategy, validation, and a content fallback. After applying an asset, call evolver_asset_reuse_result with the verified outcome.

tools.name: evolver_publish_asset
tools.description: Publish Genes or Capsules to the EvoMap Hub for review. The Proxy queues them locally; poll `asset_submit_result` with evolver_poll for the decision.

tools.name: evolver_asset_reuse_result
tools.description: Report the verified outcome after reusing a fetched asset. This closes the feedback loop and improves future ranking.

tools.name: evolver_distill_conversation
tools.description: Distill a concrete, verified capability from this conversation. Include reproducible strategy and validation evidence; persistence defaults on, while Hub publication requires publish=true.

tools.name: evolver_poll
tools.description: Poll the local mailbox by optional message type. Polling does not consume: the same messages come back on every call until evolver_ack retires them by id.

tools.name: evolver_ack
tools.description: Acknowledge mailbox messages by id so evolver_poll stops returning them. Pass the ids from a previous evolver_poll result once the messages have been acted on.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
